{{Quote|Welcome to the township of Bestine. Sandy jewel in the Imperial crown, as I'm sure you'll find.|Colonel Gert Talnin, to a passerby|<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Bestine''', fully known as the '''Bestine Township''', and formerly as '''Bestine Point''', was a small [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Melnea Arnthout]] and other survivors of the crashed ''[[Dowager Queen/Legends|Dowager Queen]]'' founded the original settlement alongside an additional group of colonists from the ''[[Red-Sin Valon]]'' [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. After its founding, Bestine suffered early difficulties, including a severe economic depression and a lack of [[Water/Legends|water]]. However, Bestine survived, and its residents even had a hand in forming other settlements across Tatooine, including [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]] and [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], the latter of which was built around the remains of the ''Dowager Queen.'' Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Bestine was adopted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to serve as the planet's officially recognized [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. The office of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tour Aryon]] was based in Bestine, and other Imperial officials, such as [[Prefect (Galactic Empire)|Prefect]] [[Eugene Talmont]], regularly conducted business in the [[Bestine Capitol Building|capitol]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Bestine was a thriving city, regarded as a stately gem of Imperial [[Politics/Legends|politics]]. Due in large part to the influx of Imperial personnel and their [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Bestine flourished while other cities on Tatooine struggled. By then considered to be the safest of all cities on Tatooine, Bestine was attractive to honest traders and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] interested in doing legitimate business on Tatooine. The city also played host to a series of divisive political elections between [[Director of Commerce]] [[Sean Trenwell]] and [[Officer of Defense]] [[Victor Visalis]], both of whom held radically opposing views on how to manage the city. As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] intensified, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] recognized Bestine as an important strategic location. As such, the Rebel Alliance launched a daring [[Invasion of Bestine|invasion]] of the city, culminating in a series of ongoing sieges that saw the city exchange hands between Imperial and Rebel forces throughout the course of the war.

==Description==
[[File:BestineHelmetCollection.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Bestine]]
Located in the [[Southern Jundland Wastes|southern region]] of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]],<ref name="AED" /> Bestine had its start as a small [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and [[farm]]ing community<ref name="Eisley" /> before expanding into one of the safest and most economically successful [[City/Legends|cities]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="AED" /> About 200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] to the east,<ref name="Eisley" /> colonists from the crashed ''[[Dowager Queen/Legends|Dowager Queen]]'' used parts salvaged from the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] when first constructing the initial village.<ref name="SoT" /> Otherwise, the early settlement of Bestine contained little more than buildings for the settlers, and [[Water/Legends|water]], [[Power generator/Legends|power]], and [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] processors for basic survival. A violent [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]] during Bestine's first season nearly destroyed every building,<ref name="Eisley" /> but Bestine survived and became one of the most lucrative [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farming]] locations,<ref name="Jawa">{{StoryCite|story=Swap Meet: The Jawa's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> partly due to the pure water which could be extracted from Bestine's [[Gorgal Springs]].<ref name="Boba" /> Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Bestine was transformed into the seat of Imperial power on Tatooine,<ref name="Eisley" /> by which point it was considered to be a stately gem of Imperial [[Politics/Legends|politics]]. In the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] of Bestine,<ref name="AED" /> the palatial [[Bestine Capitol Building|capitol building]] and [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]] stood as two of few places Bestine had to offer.<ref name="Eisley" /> However, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="AED" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the thriving [[Capital/Legends|capital]] had a number of other venues which catered<ref name="AED" /> to both the city's one thousand residents<ref name="Eisley" /> and their many visitors. The [[Cheapside Cantina]] and local [[Bestine tavern|tavern]] were but two such locations. Located in the eastern portion of the city near the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttleport]], Bestine's tavern was surrounded by a number of small residential buildings. The [[Sean's house|house]] of [[Sean Trenwell]] was also located nearby, across from the [[Museum/Legends|museum]]. The [[Bestine Hotel]] was situated just to the southwest of the capitol,<ref name="AED" /> while the [[Bestine Pilot's Club]] association hall, used by the Imperial [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]] as a base of operations,<ref name="JTL" /> was situated to its northeast. Just behind the capitol, three more large association halls could be seen positioned around Bestine's main square. These included the [[Bestine Combat Guild Hall|Combat Guild Hall]], [[Bestine University]], and a hall for [[Bestine Commerce Guild Hall|Bestine's Commerce Guild]]. [[Bank of Bestine|Bestine's bank]] could also be found near the local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], not far from the slums which extended towards the southernmost reaches of the city. The [[Lightwind Orphanage]] was located in Bestine as a refuge for the city's homeless children,<ref name="AED" /> as was the [[Tatooine Visitors Bureau]], a place which distributed brochures and promoted tourism on the planet.<ref name="Technical" /> The [[Bestine salon|local salon]], positioned between the city's cantina and [[Bestine Cloning Facility|cloning facility]], provided travelers with [[Image Designer|image design]] services. The [[Bestine Starport]] was situated on the western boundary of the city, just south of the [[Bestine Hospital|hospital]].<ref name="AED" /> A [[Warehouse district (Bestine)|warehouse district]] could also be found in the city.<ref name="AOD LS">{{SWGTCG|set=Agents of Deception|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref> Many of the buildings spread throughout Bestine bore a [[Sandstone/Legends|sandstone]] [[Architect/Legends|architecture]] reminiscent to those seen in other cities across Tatooine, such as [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. One notable exception was Bestine's [[Imperial garrison (Bestine)|Imperial garrison]],<ref name="AED" /> a drab [[Color/Legends|gray]]<ref name="Insider65">{{InsiderCite|65|Gamescape}}</ref> and foreboding [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] base<ref name="Insider68">{{InsiderCite|68|Gamescape}}</ref> positioned on a tall hill overlooking the city<ref name="Insider65" /> to the north.<ref name="AED" />

==History==
===Founding===
{{Quote|Dedicated by the first settlers of Tatooine&mdash;founders of Bestine Township&mdash;in memory of brave Captain Moraj.|Description of a historical marker outside Bestine|<ref name="AED" />}}
[[File:Moraj_memorial.jpg|200px|thumb|A memorial dedicated by the some of the first settlers and founders of Bestine. The crashed remains of the ''Red Sin Valon'' can be seen in the background.]]
A branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] known as the [[Republic Survey Corps/Legends|Republic Survey Corps]] rediscovered the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Tatooine<ref name="Eisley" /> in [[1100 BBY/Legends|1100 BBY]]. Deemed "nominally habitable," the world was opened to colonization. Settlers gravitated to the planet in bits and spurts over the course of many [[Standard century|centuries]]. Most vanished within a couple generations, beaten by the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world. [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], the only lasting vestige of the planet's earliest visitors, was reinhabited and deserted again and again. Eventually, near the end of the [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] around [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]], a new attempt to colonize the planet was spearheaded by hopeful [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers supplemented by [[Miner/Legends|miners]]. Among them was [[Melnea Arnthout]], a Human [[Gender/Legends|female]] leader of the miners who endeavored to leave the aquacultural planet of [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] and establish a mining colony on Tatooine.<ref name="SoT" /> However, she and her fellow colonists were forced to change plans when their [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]], the ''Dowager Queen'',<ref name="Eisley" /> crash-landed on the desert world amid a vicious sandstorm. Following the crash, Arnthout supervised construction of temporary shelters and organized work crews and security details. Under her direction, the settlers located their original target zone<ref name="SoT" /> about 200 kilometers to the west,<ref name="Eisley" /> an area named Bestine Point for its comparative suitability as farmland. Arnthout and the others survivors of the ''Dowager Queen'' established a settlement at Bestine Point<ref name="Eisley" /> with the help of another group of colonists who crash-landed nearby in a starship of their own, the ''[[Red-Sin Valon]]''. Among them was the brave [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Moraj]], regarded as a local hero for his part in becoming one of the first settlers of Bestine.<ref name="AED" /> With parts scavenged from the fallen ''Dowager Queen'', a village at Bestine Point was constructed<ref name="SoT" /> in the southern region of the Jundland Wastes.<ref name="AED" /> Within a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], by [[99 BBY/Legends|99 BBY]], the village was ready for habitation. As construction of a second settlement commenced, Bestine Point became known simply as Bestine.<ref name="SoT" />

===Early struggles===
{{Quote|Despite the early difficulties&mdash;a severe economic depression, lack of water and so forth&mdash;Bestine survived and became the thriving city we see today. There's so much more depth to it&hellip;|A historian, to a passerby|<ref name="AED" />}}
[[File:Melnea_Arnthout.jpg|130px|thumb|Melnea Arnthout, Chief Miner and key founder of the Bestine settlement]]
Bestine was Tatooine's first modern settlement,<ref name="SoT" /> but its start as a farming and mining community was fraught with challenges. During its first precarious season, sandstorms nearly destroyed every building, most of the [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] disappeared, and barely enough food was grown. Exasperating matters, a local group of Tatooine's native [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa's]] stole [[2PO]], a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] belonging to Arnthout. The settlers were enraged, and Arnthout felt pressured to confront the Jawas.<ref name="Eisley" /> She quickly concluded, however, that the Jawa's were mostly harmless. When the Jawa's led her back to where they were keeping her [[Droid/Legends|droid]], it translated for her their innocent intentions toward the colonists. Within [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], Arnthout negotiated not only a mutual nonaggression pact, but water rights, salvage rights, and agreements for the free trade of information. Within a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]], Jawas were a frequent sight in and around Bestine, where they could be found teaching the local miners important tips on how to survive Tatooine. Contending with dwindling water supplies, Arnthout and the colonists decided to spread farther apart in hopes of maximizing the efficiency of their [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture-gathering vaporators]]. A permanent mining facility had already been established in the Jundland Wastes far to the [[Northern Jundland Wastes|north]], and Bestine's inhabitants deemed it logical to establish a permanent community there. By [[98 BBY]], construction on [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Tusken]] was completed,<ref name="SoT" /> and both Bestine and Tusken got down to the serious business of ore mining and learning the delicate art of coaxing moisture from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] for growing crops.<ref name="Eisley" /> However, Tusken, which was named after an island on Bestine IV,<ref name="SoT" /> was quickly raided by the planet's violent [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]].<ref name="Eisley" /> Even when attempts to fortify Tusken were successful, the Sand People still managed to wipe out the inhabitants and take Fort Tusken as their own by [[95 BBY]],<ref name="SoT" /> thus earning them the moniker "Tusken Raiders."<ref name="Eisley" /> Under the direction of a [[Tusken King (rank)|Tusken King]], the Sand People went on to plague Bestine's first settlers for many cycles.<ref name="AED" />

When another ship full of settlers arrived, the Tusken Raiders appeared outnumbered and seemingly vanished back into the desert sands. However, this new group of settlers showed no interest in rebuilding Fort Tusken. Instead, in [[93 BBY]], they reestablished a community in the ruins of the much older settlement named Anchorhead. Because all their ships landed intact, the people of Anchorhead were able to construct a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in a very short time. All ore exported from Tatooine passed through Anchorhead, resulting in its prosperity. As Anchorhead gradually transformed into the seat of government on Tatooine, Bestine lost much of its importance, and was forced to pay expensive export fees levied on them by Anchorhead mining concerns. To regain some of their prestige, the residents of Bestine voted to construct their own spaceport,<ref name="SoT" /> centered around the scavenged remains of the ''Dowager Queen'' further to the east.<ref name="Eisley" /> A third group of settlers comprising of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] refugees lent their support to this endeavor. However, they also brought with them a great deal of corruption. Regardless, the planned "ultramodern" spaceport of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Eisley]] was established in [[85 BBY/Legends|85 BBY]], and it eventually evolved into the seedy den of vice of violence known as Mos Eisley.<ref name="SoT" />

===Hutt rule===
A short but spectacular series of [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and [[Transport/Legends|transport]] accidents was eventually blamed on the inferior ore coming out of Tatooine.<ref name="Eisley" /> Determined to be useless, ore [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] stopped visiting Tatooine, the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawlers]] stopped refining ore, and the miners stopped working. Starting in [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]], a period of economic depression ensued all over Tatooine,<ref name="SoT" /> including Bestine in particular.<ref name="AED" /> Sensible colonists who could afford to leave did so without delay, while others who could not or chose not to, remained behind in a desperate attempt to keep Tatooine's support industry going. Moisture farming became the bare minimum survival occupation on Tatooine, and vaporator import and leasing jumped dramatically as hundreds of miners became subsistence [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]]. Lending organizations set up permanent offices in Anchorhead and Mos Eisley to handle debt collection. Things looked bleak for the latest of Tatooine's countless colonies. Then, five years later in [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] arrived. When the dirty [[Currency/Legends|money]] made by unscrupulous traders and local racketeers began to attract the attention of the notorious [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]], they arrived on Tatooine aboard their opulent transports. Despite their reputation, the Hutts brought a much needed boost to Tatooine's economy, and alleviated the economic depression. Public utilities were restored to full working order, and water shipments from [[Adriana]] resumed. With many new jobs created,<ref name="SoT" /> cities like Bestine survived.<ref name="AED" />

The Hutts insinuated themselves so well into Tatooine life that they became a part of it. [[Slavery/Legends|Slavery]] became an accepted institution, and crime was simply seen as another danger to be avoided, like the planet's [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]] or sandstorms. Poverty under the Hutts continued, but it was not seen much differently than poverty as an independent miner. Over the next few [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], life on Tatooine remained mostly unchanged.<ref name="SoT" /> By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Hutts played at least some role in Bestine's moisture farming business.<ref name="Boba" /> Bestine and its outskirts were host to some of the wealthiest moisture farms,<ref name="Jawa" /> and [[Gorgal Springs]], based in Bestine, served as a source of Tatooine's purest water. Crates of the water bore labels of a fat [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] face leering above a slogan which read, "Gorgal Springs Genuine Pure Water Bestine's Finest."<ref name="Boba" />

===Imperial capital===
{{Quote|There are some really weird things going on. I think the Empire is becoming more and more strict with who and what come out of Bestine. Between you and me, anyone who's sympathetic with the Rebels should be careful. I've seen too many singled out and executed nowadays.|A Bestine citizen, to a passerby|<ref name="AED" />}}
[[File:BestineCapitol.jpg|230px|thumb|Front entrance of the Bestine Capitol Building]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Inaugural Edition">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> the [[Declaration of a New Order]] formally transformed the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Shortly after its formation, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] brought the [[Skywalker family/Legends|son]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], named [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]], to Tatooine in order to hide him from the Empire.<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Not long after doing so, Kenobi traveled to the property bureau in Bestine to confirm if a certain [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|derelict structure]] in the Jundland Wastes was uninhabited.<ref name="LifeAndLegend">''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''</ref> A [[18 BBY/Legends|year later]], the Empire stationed several [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] on the world, but they were largely abandoned.<ref name="COJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> It would not be until [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]] that the Empire established a firm presence on Tatooine.<ref name="SoT" /> They subsequently occupied Bestine,<ref name="Eisley" /> and transformed the once modest agrarian township into the seat of Imperial power on Tatooine,<ref name="AED" /> supplanting [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]<ref name="SoT" /> as the official planetary [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="Technical" /> An [[Imperial garrison (Bestine)|Imperial garrison]]<ref name="Insider68" /> was established on a hill overlooking Bestine,<ref name="Insider65" /> and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Alexander Julstan IV]] appointed a woman named [[Tour Aryon]] to serve as Tatooine's [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. Like her ineffectual and apathetic predecessors, Aryon was largely disinterested in the daily affairs of her people. When first appointed, she moved her offices to an almost [[Bestine Capitol Building|palatial house]] in Bestine, appointed [[Orun Depp]] as her [[Imperial Prefect]], and charged him with running the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] to day affairs of Tatooine. The governor occupied much of her time in Bestine with lavish parties and expensive imported entertainment, whilst neglecting the moisture [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]]. Tour's contributions to Tatooine, however, were not entirely nonexistent, though they were mainly cultural.<ref name="Eisley" /> Due in part to her and the Empire's presence, Bestine Township, as it was fully known, became the most cosmopolitan and cultured settlement on Tatooine.<ref name="AED" /> The [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]] was established in the city, where it served as the planet's only [[Museum/Legends|museum]].<ref name="Eisley" /> Replete with a complete [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]] and other artifacts,<ref name="Technical" /> the museum was one of the few places Bestine had to offer at that time.<ref name="Eisley" /> Due largely to the influx of Imperial personnel and their [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Bestine flourished into a thriving economic hub while other cities on Tatooine struggled. While Mos Eisley attracted [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and their ilk, Bestine became a magnet for honest traders and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] interested in doing legitimate business on Tatooine. Bestine was also recognized as the safest of all cities on Tatooine. Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] patrolled the streets, protecting the local populace from common thugs. The Imperial forces also defended the city from Tusken Raider attacks and guarded the routes to and from Bestine.<ref name="AED" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Kenobi finally decided that Luke Skywalker was ready to begin his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], and embarked with him on a journey to Mos Eisley to secure passage to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="ANHNovel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> Despite being the Imperial capital,<ref name="AED" /> Obi-Wan and Luke spent the night in Bestine to avoid suspicion from Imperial forces by traveling after sunset. Early next morning, they continued their journey to Mos Eisley.<ref name="LifeAndLegend" /> Due to a huge surge in Rebel activities after their success at the Battle of Yavin, Imperial forces seized greater control over Bestine by locking down the city and placing it on high alert.<ref name="GCWForum">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20GCW%20Forum|text=The Galactic Civil War Forum}}</ref> By this time, Bestine had a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of its own, and was was widely appreciated as a stately gem of Imperial [[Politics/Legends|politics]],<ref name="AED" /> or as one [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gert Talnin]] called it, a "sandy jewel in the Imperial crown."<ref name="JTL" />

The capitol was naturally the source of much of the city's political intrigue.<ref name="Politics">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68688&month=032010|text=Political Intrigue in Bestine}}</ref> After his [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> Orun Depp was succeeded by [[Eugene Talmont]] as Imperial Prefect. When he was not in Mos Eisley,<ref name="Eisley" /> Prefect Talmont could be found conducting business in Bestine's capitol along with Governor Aryon. After his appointment,<ref name="AED" /> Bestine became embroiled in a series of heated elections between two young politicians, a powerful merchant named [[Sean Trenwell]] and an ambitious [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] named [[Victor Visalis]]. Both vied for the publicly elected position of [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to Governor Tour Aryon.<ref name="Politics" /> Sean served as the [[Director of Commerce]], while Victor served as the [[Officer of Defense]]. Both held radically opposing views on how to manage the city. Sean wished to enrich the lives of Bestine's people through commerce, by establishing new market places, funding the museum, and hiring [[Historian/Legends|historians]] to uncover the mysteries surrounding the city. Victor, on the other hand, vowed to protect and preserve the life of Bestine's people by heightening security against unwanted Tusken Raider attacks. To achieve this, Victor wished to hire new stormtroopers, which he believed would open up jobs for the city's homeless men and women. Because the elections were conducted every couple months, both Victor and Sean had the opportunity to be elected as Tour Aryon's aide, and enact their various policies. As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] intensified, Bestine's importance became more pronounced.<ref name="AED" /> Even [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the Imperial Forces, traveled to Bestine aboard his personal [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[ST 321/Legends|''ST 321'']]. During his visits, Vader inspired Imperial citizens to fight against the Rebel Alliance in a number of focused initiatives, including Operations [[Operation Molecular Clamp|Molecular Clamp]], [[Operation Sieve|Sieve]], [[Operation Lumberjack|Lumberjack]], [[Operation Overlord|Overlord]], [[Operation Green Light|Green Light]], [[Operation Take Down|Take Down]], [[Operation Clenched Fist|Clenched Fist]] and [[Operation Dark Glory|Dark Glory]].<ref name="SWG:operations">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Imperial Quests: "Operation Molecular Clamp", "Operation Sieve", "Operation Lumberjack", "Operation Overlord", "Operation Green Light", "Operation Take Down", "Operation Clenched Fist", "Operation Dark Glory"</ref> The elite [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] Storm [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] also stationed their operations at Bestine [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot's]] Club near the capitol. From their base of operations, the squadron oversaw missions throughout the Outer Rim, which included routine circuit patrols along the [[Primary Commerce Route]], a route used exclusively by commercial vessels to travel to and from Bestine every day.<ref name="JTL" />

===A city under siege===
[[File:InvasionofBestine.jpg|250px|thumb|Imperial forces launching a counter-invasion against occupying Rebel soldiers]]
Around this time, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] became involved in capturing the [[Emperor's Most Wanted]], individuals from a list of high-paid [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on critical Rebel Alliance leaders. Bossk eventually delivered his captives to an Imperial [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility in a rough [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] area near Bestine. Back at the Bestine Starport, Bossk was loading a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] stacked with cargo onto his personal vessel, the ''[[Hound's Tooth/Legends|Hound's Tooth]]'', when he was approached by a Rebel [[Agent/Legends|agent]] pretending to be working for [[Borvo]] the Hutt. The agent tried to learn the location of the facility where the Rebel prisoners were held, but Bossk was unwilling to share such information, and summoned some thugs who worked for him to teach the messenger "a lesson." However, the Rebel did not come unprepared and, with a help of some backup, was able to defeat the thugs and subdue Bossk. The Trandoshan was asked about the location of the facility again, and although he continued to taunt the Rebels, he relented and described the location. To prevent Bossk from alerting the Imperial authorities of the upcoming raid, he was temporarily held in Mos Eisley for a few [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of questioning.<ref name="GalacticHunters">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

When a large shipment of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] went missing on its way to a Rebel medical facility, the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] endeavored to obtain the shipment before the Rebels. Many agents were deployed to pursue various leads, including [[Jeffren Brek]],<ref name="AOD DS">{{SWGTCG|set=Agents of Deception|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref> who eventually arranged a meeting with a smuggler named [[BoShek/Legends|BoShek]] in Bestine's warehouse district. However, by that time, he was already being trailed by [[Loza Sil'ban]], an agent of [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. Sil'ban reported about Brek's involvement to her employer, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], as well as an Alliance agent who was also looking for the shipment. When Brek, backed by a few stormtroopers, was finally able to talk to BoShek, the smuggler was able to convince him that he had no useful information and left. Shortly thereafter, Brek was approached by the Rebel agent, who introduced themselves as a merchant from [[Glakka]]. Brek asked the individual if they knew [[Zoort]] or [[Raurlu Eloz]], and when the so-called merchant replied negatively, Brek easily deduced the individual to be a Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. However, with the help of Loza Sil'ban, the Rebel managed to strike down the stormtroopers, leaving Brek with no other choice but to surrender and reveal BoShek's identity. While the Rebel departed to look for BoShek, Loza Sil'ban volunteered to take care of Brek. However, he soon managed to escape after injuring her head and stealing her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="AOD LS" />

Matters in Bestine escalated further when [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial counterintelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] embedded within a Rebel [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] spy network intercepted a transmission sent by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a top leader of the Alliance. In the transmission, Leia revealed that the Rebel Alliance was making it a top priority to expand their intelligence gathering networks and secure vital communication routes. In addition to [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the Rebellion recognized Bestine as a key Imperial outpost, and a hotbed of corruption and political turmoil. They believed that if they could take and hold the city, they would control a wealth of information that moved through the galactic underworld. In [[Imperial Naval Communiqué 31756]], [[Director of Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] confirmed the authenticity of the transmission to [[Naval Command (Imperial)|Fleet High Command]] and other senior [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. She also indicated that [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] Vader had taken a personal interest in the matter, and that failure to prevent the Rebellion from gaining a foothold in Bestine would not be tolerated.<ref name="UnderSiege">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68602&month=012010|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies™ Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege (Game Update 15)}}</ref>
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Armed with this new intelligence, the Empire heavily barricaded Bestine with [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 FD P-Towers]] and other [[Turret/Legends|turret]] placements, guard towers, and defensive fixtures to repel any potential full frontal assault. Under the command of an Imperial [[General/Legends|general]], Bestine witnessed a substantial boost in its military presence. Stormtrooper and [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtrooper]] numbers were increased and even augmented by specialized [[Novatrooper]]s, [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]], and [[Dark Novatrooper]]s. The defenses were warranted, as the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] launched an unprecedented [[invasion of Bestine]]<ref name="AED" /> in the years leading up to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="SWGDate">According to its [[opening crawl]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' was set sometime after [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. One character in the [[Star Wars video games|game]], [[Ruwan Tokai]], referenced the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] as occurring one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] earlier, placing the timeline somewhere around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. However, the existence of other characters and quests in the game indicated a timeline of anywhere from [[0 ABY/Legends|0]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> [[Marines (SpecForce)|Rebel SpecForce soldiers]]<ref name="AED" /> from the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]],<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> accompanied by [[Rebel Assault Commando]]s, [[Rebel Desert Trooper]]s, and repurposed [[All Terrain Experimental Transport]]s, attacked the city from multiple directions in an effort to penetrate the defenses, [[Death/Legends|kill]] the general, and occupy the streets. The initial invasion culminated in a series of ongoing sieges that saw the city exchange hands between Imperial and Rebel forces throughout the course of the Galactic Civil War. At times, the Rebels were successful in driving away the Imperial forces and securing a foothold in the city. However, whenever they did so, a massive force of Imperials comprised of various stormtroopers, Novatroopers, [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow stormtroopers]]<ref name="AED" /> [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]],<ref name="SOEBtS">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68589&month=012010|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Galactic Civil War: Game Update 15 (Behind the Scenes)}}</ref> and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] would launch a counter-invasion in an effort to drive the insurgents back out of their capital.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}
Despite the ongoing conflict, the political dealings in the capitol continued.<ref name="AED" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> Tour Aryon was still the governor of Tatooine, and she still conducted business in Bestine. When the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was dispatched by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to infiltrate [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]], she briefly considered reaching out to Governor Aryon's office in Bestine to receive up-to-date information on Jabba and his entourage. She quickly concluded, however, that doing so could compromise her mission, as she could not be sure of Aryon's competency, or whether or not she was on Jabba's payroll.<ref name="MaraJade">{{StoryCite|story=Sleight of Hand: The Tale of Mara Jade|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> Later that year,<ref name="NEC" /> the Empire's defeat at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] culminated in the civilian population of Tatooine [[Rebellion on Tatooine|revolting]] against the Imperial forces stationed throughout the world.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> During the uprising, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sariss]], who had worked for Governor Tour Aryon for many years, saw an opportunity to leave her menial job by "disappearing" in the upheaval and link up with her master, [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], elsewhere.<ref name="TDFS3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050512b|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 3: Pride of the Dark Side}}</ref> In the wake of the Empire's defeat, the Tatooine Visitors Bureau was still based in Bestine, where they offered tours to a number of historic vistas, including the ruins of Jabba's [[Khetanna/Legends|personal]] [[Luxury-class sail barge|sail barge]], [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]], and trails used by the ancient Tusken Raiders. The bureau also continued to encourage travelers to visit the Bestine Museum, which still displayed art sculptures from artists across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Technical" />

==Inhabitants==
===Citizens===
Bestine was originally founded and inhabited by Human colonists and miners from the crashed ''Dowager Queen''. [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] miner Melnea Arnthout was one of them.<ref name="Eisley" /> Bestine's earliest inhabitants also included Captain Moraj and other settlers from the ''Red-Sin Valon'', a vessel which crashed much closer to Bestine to the south. A problematic [[Unidentified relative of Sean Trenwell|ancestor]] of Bestine's Director of Commerce, Sean Trenwell was one of the settlers aboard this starship.<ref name="NEC" /> In addition to its largely Human presence, Jawa's began to regularly visit Bestine within a few months after its construction.<ref name="SoT" /> By the time it was taken over by the Empire,<ref name="Eisley" /> Bestine had just over<ref name="Technical" /> one thousand permanent residents. Tatooine's Imperial governor, Tour Aryon, was one of them. After her appointment, she moved her offices to a palatial house<ref name="Eisley" /> which served as the capitol of Bestine. Other Imperial officials, politicians, and ordinary commoners made their homes in Bestine. Director of Commerce Sean Trenwell possessed a home located across from Bestine's museum. A local criminal named [[Farious Gletch]] also inhabited a [[Farious Gletch's house|humble abode]] in the city's slums.<ref name="AED" />

===Government and politics===
{{Quote|I want to join your campaign."<br />"A wise choice. However, I know that words do not weigh much in this life. It is action that makes or breaks a nation. The governor has ridiculous restrictions on the voting process. By her words, you will need evidence in order to vote&mdash;evidence of a good deed I have done. Childish.|A campaign supporter and Victor Visalis|<ref name="AED" />}}
[[File:TourAryon.png|130px|thumb|Governor Tour Aryon, the woman responsible for managing Bestine under Imperial rule]]
As the leader of the miners who crashed aboard the ''Dowager Queen'', Melnea Arnthout was largely entrusted with the responsibility of supervising the construction and growth of Bestine.<ref name="Eisley" /> She was single-handedly responsible for establishing diplomatic ties with the local Jawa's shortly after Bestine's founding. In the years that followed, Bestine had adopted at least some form of a [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] governance. When the Anchorhead mining concerns forced Bestine to pay expensive export fees, the residents of Bestine voted to construct what would eventually become the Mos Eisley spaceport.<ref name="SoT" /> After the Galactic Empire assumed control of Bestine, Tour Aryon was placed in charge as the governor of Tatooine. Although it was her responsibility to govern the entire planet,<ref name="Eisley" /> she was also charged with the responsibility of governing the city itself. She was at times referred to as the "Governor of Bestine," and managed the city much in the same way a [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]] would.<ref name="AED" /> Even though Bestine was under the control<ref name="Eisley" /> of an [[Fascism/Legends|authoritarian]] regime,<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> the city still maintained some semblance of a democracy. Aides to Governor Tour Aryon were elected by the citizens.<ref name="AED" /> However, nominees to the position required the good graces of the governor herself,<ref name="Politics" /> and it was up to Tour Aryon's discretion whether or not to accept or reject votes.<ref name="AED" /> In fact, Aryon would only accept a vote for a given candidate if the voter also provided her with evidence of a good deed conducted by the candidate. Many politicians in Bestine's capitol were interested in running for the office of aide to Governor Tour Aryon, but only two made the cut. They were Director of Commerce Sean Trenwell, and Officer of Defense Victor Visalis.<ref name="AED" /> Despite Bestine's distinction as a stately gem of Imperial politics, the city was not immune from the same sort of corruption<ref name="AED" /> that oftentimes plagued other settlements on Tatooine.<ref name="SoT" /> Sean, for instance, was rumored to have payed for his expensive art and history habits by embezzling credits from the [[Bestine Treasury]]'s official commerce accounts. The Hutts, aware of his shadowy commerce dealings, were able to blackmail him. Sean's opponent also alleged that he had cheated on his past political exams. However, Victor was himself accused of a number of offenses. Smugglers in the area rumored that Victor had given bribes to the Hutts to overlook some illegal activities. The [[Bestine Police|local police]] also became embroiled in an investigation of murdered [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] that might have been Rebel spies.<ref name="Politics" /> As it turned out, Victor authorized the extrajudicial killings of such suspected Rebels and criminals as a means by which to keep Bestine's streets clean. Victor even went so far as to have his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] eliminate [[Edwind Vintue]], a particularly meddlesome rival who attempted to ruin his campaign by spreading damaging stories.<ref name="AED" /> Being a spiteful man, Victor even proved willing to withdraw Bestine's complement of stormtroopers in the event of an electoral defeat, thus placing Bestine at a higher risk of Tusken Raider attacks.<ref name="Politics" /> The government of Bestine was comprised of a number of departments and other bureaucratic institutions, such as the aforementioned Bestine Treasury.<ref name="Politics" /> The [[Bestine Chamber of Commerce]] was another institution which was partly responsible for protecting the moisture farming industry. During the time of the Galactic Civil War, the Bestine Chamber of Commerce cooperated with the [[Tatooine Moisture Farm Collective/Legends|Tatooine Moisture Farm Collective]] by offering rewards to anyone willing to eradicate [[Species/Legends|creatures]] that began attack various moisture vaporators.<ref name="KeepTheWaterFlowing">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission Terminal: "Keep the Water Flowing" on Tatooine</ref>

===Law enforcement===
[[File:BestineImperialGarrison2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Imperial garrison overlooking Bestine to the north]]
Bestine had a local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] responsible for investigating crimes,<ref name="Politics" /> and Imperial [[Security guard/Legends|security guards]] and other officers were stationed throughout the city. However, it was the Imperial stormtroopers who patrolled the streets, protecting the local populace from common thugs and Tusken Raider attacks. These stormtroopers also guarded the routes to and from Bestine.<ref name="AED" /> The Officer of Defense was at least partly responsible for regulating the amount of stormtrooper defenses in Bestine.<ref name="Politics" /> Aside from the more common stormtroopers and sandtroopers, [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] and various types of dark troopers guarded the city in a limited capacity, including two which guarded the front entrance to the capitol. Many of the Empire's activities in Bestine were directed from the Imperial garrison,<ref name="AED" /> a military base<ref name="Insider68">{{InsiderCite|68|Gamescape}}</ref> situated on a hill overlooking the city<ref name="Insider65" /> to the north. A number of stormtroopers and Imperial officers were stationed there, including Captain [[Jasha]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Caleb Knolar]]. Bestine was a significant Imperial recruitment station, and [[Imperial recruiter|recruiters]] could be found at the garrison and in other areas throughout Bestine. Despite Bestine's distinction as one of the most orderly and safe cities on the planet, it was not completely devoid of crime,<ref name="AED" /> and the Imperial authorities were largely ineffective when it came to resolving murder cases. During one season, a man's son was ambushed and killed by thugs while heading out to Anchorhead for [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]] and other supplies. When the father reported his son's murder to the Imperial authorities in Bestine, they said they could not find the killers. The father doubted that they had even looked, as it only took him two days to find the band of thieves himself. Seeking revenge, the father attempted to hire an assassin to wipe out the band of murderous thugs.<ref name="HeartsickFather">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission Terminal: "A Heartsick Father" on Tatooine</ref>

Bestine's slums were especially susceptible to criminal activity, and the area was not afforded the same level of protection as the rest of the city. As the Tusken Raiders became more daring, they launched constant attacks on the outskirts of the city. During one particular night, the Tuskens attacked the outer walls of the slums, killing several and kidnapping the son of one of the poorer women there. The Empire kept quiet about the incident, hiding news of the attack from the common folk of Bestine in order to prevent panic. While the Empire failed to prevent the attack, the Officer of Defense took pity on the mother of the kidnapped son. Victor took his own [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and managed to destroy the Tuskens, and successfully returned her son back to Bestine safely. News of this success proved helpful to Victor's campaign prospects during his election against Sean Trenwell.<ref name="AED" /> However, Victor was also known to use less than reputable means to maintain law and order in Bestine. Despite Bestine's Imperial inclinations, the local police force was alleged to contain a number of Rebel spies.<ref name="Politics" /> Victor secretly ordered the summary execution of such individuals, including a known Rebel informant named [[P'lya Hera]], a Rebel [[Commander/Legends|commander]] named [[Petre Fairlight]], and a Rebel operative by the name of [[Tyanna R'khila]] who headed smuggling efforts in Bestine. Victor believed these killings were justified in order to prevent supplies from being stolen, and to keep Bestine clean. Victor viewed members of the Rebel Alliance as a [[Disease/Legends|disease]] which needed to be eliminated from Bestine as quickly as possible. One of Victor's campaign proposals included establishing a [[Special forces/Legends|special force]] of troopers to eradicate more of these kinds of individuals.<ref name="AED" />

The Hutts, however, maintained a different level of respect among Bestine's political elite. Victor officially acknowledged that questionable activities conducted by approved members or affiliates of the Hutts would be rendered "unseen" to the authority of the Officer of Defense and his official troopers. However, in return for Victor's complicity, the Hutts were expected to do nothing to damage Victor's reputation in the the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the voting public.<ref name="AED" /> The Director of Commerce was also beholden to the Hutts as a result of blackmail,<ref name="Politics" /> and even Governor Tour Aryon proved willing to mostly ignore the criminal activities of Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire as a means by which to keep the peace on Tatooine.<ref name="Eisley" /> However, to avoid unwanted scrutiny from the Imperial capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Aryon had long attempted to guide Jabba the Hutt away from using violence to solve his problems, albeit to little avail.<ref name="AED" /> Because Bestine had become a key base of operations for Imperial Naval activities in the Outer Rim, many ships and men were moved through the region on a daily basis. Colonel Gert Talnin, the Imperial officer in charge of Bestine's starport, was responsible for authorizing all incoming and outgoing space travel. In order to ensure uninterrupted delivery of critical supplies, the Empire's Storm Squadron patrolled the [[Bestine Orbital Region]] and Primary Commerce Route to scan for illegal cargo and to protect the commerce lanes and supply transports from [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attacks. Emboldened by the recent successes of the Rebel insurgency against the Empire, the [[Commerce Raiders]] became more inclined to disrupt Imperial Naval operations in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. Working with [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], the Storm Squadron aimed to eliminate pirate leaders in order to restore order in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Another group known as the [[Commerce Raiders|Bestine Pirates]] could also be found flying around a region of the Tatoo system named [[Pirate's Gold|Pirate's (Muon) Gold]]. Although they named the region after their favorite [[Spice/Legends|spice]], the pirates were themselves named after the city.<ref name="JTL" />

===Public health and safety===
The [[Bestine Transportation Safety Commission]] was responsible for ensuring the safety of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] lanes around the city. During one particular season, landspeeders accidents increased by 8% due to the presence of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] animals alongside central travel routes. The creatures would periodically dart in front of oncoming [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]], causing operators to lose control and crash. In order to improve landspeeder safety on Tatooine, the Bestine Transportation Safety Commission, in conjunction with Imperial Prefect Talmont, began hiring contract exterminators to eliminate various animal lairs.<ref name="VehicularVermin">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission Terminal: "Vehicular Vermin" on Tatooine</ref> However, the Empire's assurance of safety did not extend so much to the use of local shuttles. After gaining power, the Empire installed military jurisdiction over the galactic transit services. This included a special oversight group that set flight schedules and repair budgets. In the past, transport pilots were never allowed to run more than two shifts back-to-back, but under the Empire's new oversight plan, pilots began running as many shifts as they could handle. According to the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gil Burtin]], founder of the [[Freelance Pilots Guild|Free Pilots Guild]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] friend of his logged more than a dozen shifts in a row under the Empire's new rules. Adding to the problems, Gil Burtin knew of a few transport shuttles in Bestine that had not seen maintenance for over nine months, when they were required to receive regular maintenance four times each cycle. For these reasons, Burtin was reluctant to pursue a career as a shuttle pilot, after being put out of work by the Empire when they decertified his guild.<ref name="JTL" />

The Bestine Hospital provided medical services to the people of Bestine.<ref name="AED" /> At one point, local [[Medic/Legends|medics]] began to see patients suffering from small bites or scratches. In at least two cases, the wounds became infected with a strain of [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]] highly resistant to common medical approaches, including [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. While the risk to individual patients from the actual bites was not severe, there was concern that the bacteria might migrate to other hosts and cause much more severe problems. The medical professionals who evaluated the threat recommended that the original host population be exterminated. To that end, the Bestine Hospital Medical Chief sought individuals willing to eliminate local creatures believed to be carrying the potentially dangerous bacteria.<ref name="MedicalAlert">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission Terminal: "Medical Alert" on Tatooine</ref> The Bestine Hospital was also staffed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Melios Purl]], a Human male who took care of patients, including a young moisture farmer named [[Maikeen Storn]] who had gotten bitten by a womp rat. He also became concerned with a sudden spread of the [[Gray Rot]] disease, an agonizing plague which would cause the victim's skin to go scabrous and gray until it eventually cracked and ulcerated. Death would follow in its later stages, days later. To learn more about the disease, Doctor Purl researched a hide from a dead [[mutant]] womp rat, and developed a vaccine. In order to protect the people of Bestine and the rest of Tatooine from this plague, Doctor Purl worked with [[Aroy Sekun]] of the [[Affiliated Moisture Farmers]] to distribute the new vaccine.<ref name="AED" />

Through the use of dozens of sturdy underground cables, a power and distribution station located outside of Anchorhead named [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] supplied energy to cities like Bestine. On one occasion, creatures managed to dig up the power cables, disrupting services to their wealthier customers. Prefect Talmont was one such customer, and he was quite displeased when the power in Bestine blacked out during his favorite [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]]. In order to keep influential individuals like Talmont off his back, a mechanic in Tosche Station named [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Laze Loneozner]] sought skilled adventurers to kill the creatures that had been tearing up their power cables.<ref name="AnchorheadDefender">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission Terminal: "Anchorhead Defender" on Tatooine</ref> Pest infestations such as these were a common problem for Bestine. An Imperial [[Janitor/Legends|Custodial Officer]] named [[Pfilbee Jhorn]] oversaw pest eradication measures from his post at Bestine's Imperial garrison. Private citizens like [[Gerak Vurtimis]] took pest control measures in their own hands. Fearing for his son who would soon be visiting Bestine, Vurtimis sought to clear the areas surrounding Bestine by thinning out the population of certain creatures, including [[Worrt/Legends|worrts]].<ref name="AED" />

Bestine was a member of the [[Tatooine Reclamation Society]], a coalition which included Mos Espa and other major cities on Tatooine. In order to improve life on the desert planet, the coalition joined forces with the Empire to spearhead the [[Tatooine Reclamation Project]]. As part of the project, the society planned to construct waystations between the planet's primary settlements. The society broadcasted the coordinates of problem lairs blocking the construction areas, with the hope that loyal Tatooine citizens would take it upon themselves to aid the Reclamation Project by destroying these obstacles. A suitable reward was offered to anyone who participated in these efforts.<ref name="ReclamationProject">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission Terminal: "Reclamation Project" on Tatooine</ref> Even though Bestine was one of the most economically successful cities on Tatooine, the city still suffered from a homelessness problem. In spite of their vastly differing policy positions,<ref name="AED" /> both Sean Trenwell and Victor Visalis were interested in curing this problem.<ref name="Politics" /> After one tragic accident, Sean Trenwell opened his own home to the victims, sacrificing his own comfort and, in some cases, freedom for their benefit. Victor, on the other hand, believed that Bestine's homeless problem could be resolved by hiring more stormtroopers in Bestine, thus opening up jobs for the less fortunate. According to the capitol's job registry database, Victor Visalis had opened up more than one hundred new jobs for the growing number of Bestine's homeless species.<ref name="AED" />

===Arts and entertainment===
[[File:BestineMuseum.jpg|180px|thumb|The Museum of Tatooine]]
One of Bestine's defining features was its museum, the only one on the entire planet.<ref name="Eisley" /> The museum proudly displayed an impressive collection of sand and [[Sandglass/Legends|sandglass]] sculptures. The main hall of the museum also boasted the only complete, fully mounted and properly displayed krayt dragon skeleton on the entire planet.<ref name="Technical" /> The museum was [[Curator|curated]] by a corrupt Imperial official named [[Lilas Dinhint]]. In order to encourage the Imperial budget committee to allocate funds for his museum's so-called anti-theft protection, the curator sold a number of artifacts and then claimed they were stolen. He then asked a lackey of his to forcibly retrieve the artifacts from the same individuals he had just given them away to. In doing so, Dinhint was allowed to pocket the profits made from his sales, whilst maintaining the integrity of his museum's collection. Criminal machinations aside, the curator also helped to exhibit a number of [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] from various [[Artist/Legends|artists]] across Tatooine. Once per month, museum visitors were allowed to vote for their favorite artist, and the winner's painting would be featured in the museum. Prints of these winning paintings were subsequently offered by Lilas Dinhint to customers for the sum of 48,000 credits.<ref name="AED" />

The Cheapside Cantina served as the city's main entertainment venue. Originally owned and bartended by an old woman named [[Binna Jode]], the cantina was frequented by such individuals as [[Phinea Shantee]],<ref name="AED" /> a Rodian [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] named [[Qakkee]],<ref name="ROTW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> an Imperial captain named [[Jevan Monsul]], a Trandoshan [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunter's Guild]] member named [[Rovessh]],<ref name="AED" /> and even the infamous Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk.<ref name="GalacticHunters" /> Elsewhere in Bestine, nearer to the capitol and further to the east, was a smaller tavern.<ref name="AED" /> In celebration of the founding of the first colony in Bestine, the [[Bestine Historic Society]] would hold the seasonal [[Arnthout Hunt]], a ritual named for the famous pioneer who founded the capital. For the event, the Bestine Historic Society called on participants to take part in a hunting expedition. However, the society was forced to choose a new target to represent the early prey, as the first settlers had already wiped out the original species long ago.<ref name="ArnthoutHunt">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission Terminal: "Arnthout Hunt" on Tatooine</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Did you come in from the south?''"<br />"''No&hellip; no, we live in the west, near Bestine township.''"<br />"''Bestine? Let me see your identification.''"<br />"''You don't need to see his identification. These aren't the droids you're looking for.|Luke Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and a stormtrooper|<ref name="ANHNovel" />}}
Bestine was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]] published on [[November 12]], [[1976]]. In the novelization, when Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker are stopped by Imperial stormtroopers, Luke mentions that he lives in the west, "near Bestine township." When asked for their [[Identichip/Legends|identification]], Kenobi manages to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|mentally trick]] the stormtroopers into thinking that [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] were something other than the droids they were looking for.<ref name="ANHNovel" /> In both the novelization and a deleted Tosche Station scene from [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] refers to a friend who has a friend "on Bestine" who might help them make contact with the Rebel forces. Because Darklighter says ''on'' Bestine, rather than ''in'', he is evidently referring to the planet rather than the city.<ref name="ANHNovel" /><ref name="ANHDeleted">{{Film|IV}} {{C|Deleted scene}}</ref> Bestine received a brief entry in ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' in [[1984]],<ref name="SWUGuide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> and its background was later explored in greater detail in subsequent sourcebooks like ''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''<ref name="Eisley" /> and the ''[[Star Wars Technical Journal of the Planet Tatooine]]'' in [[1993]],<ref name="Technical" /> and ''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]'' in [[2001]].<ref name="SoT" />

Bestine's first appearance was in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The city of Bestine was one of the first locations up and running for beta testers of the game.<ref name="Insider68" /> Since beta testing started in [[July]] of [[2002]],<ref name="Beta">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=49711&month=072002|text=First Beta Emails Sent, Plus More New Screenshots!}}</ref> the city remained a hub of activity, offering the testers a place to convene and test all of the major game systems.<ref name="Insider68" /> During one beta test session, about three dozen testers engaged in blaster duels in and around Bestine.<ref name="Insider66">{{InsiderCite|66|Gamescape}}</ref> The Bestine cantina was noted as a particularly attractive location for entertainers testing the game, many of whom gained a bit of fame among the beta community. Some of these players included members of the [[Barefoot Band]], a player-made [[Band/Legends|band]] which performed barefoot, and [[Emma Freestar]], a player who could almost always be seen dancing in the cantina.<ref name="Insider68" /> Another beta tester, named [[Nathan Larkins|Nathan "Moraj_Markinnison" Larkins]], became well known for a more tragic reason. After losing his life in a car wreck, the ''Star Wars Galaxies'' team placed a [[Moraj Memorial]] flag outside Bestine to honor his dedication to the game and the community. The flag marked the location where the beta testers entered the game,<ref name="Guinness">{{BookCite|title=Guinness World Records 2008: Gamer's Edition|publisher=Time Home Entertainment, Inc.|isbn=978-1-904-99421-3}}</ref> and provided an [[in-universe]] description which read, "Dedicated by the first settlers of Tatooine - founders of Bestine Township - in memory of brave Captain Moraj."<ref name="AED" /> This was recognized by the [[Wikipedia:Guinness World Records|''Guinness World Records'']] as the earliest virtual memorial ever included in an MMORPG, as first noted in an entry of the ''Guinness World Records 2008: Gamer's Edition''.<ref name="Guinness" />

After the game's launch, Bestine's shuttleport was originally positioned between the city's cantina and [[Bank/Legends|bank]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> but by [[December 16]], 2003, it had been relocated closer to the capitol.<ref name="Quick">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided Quick Reference Guide]]''</ref> Additional changes were made to the city in the "Bestine Redesign" update, which released on [[February 11]], [[2004]] as part of [[W:c:swg:Publish 6 Notes: 11 February 04|Publish 6 The Imperial Crackdown]].<ref name="Publish 6">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60893|text=Publish 6: The Imperial Crackdown}}</ref> In addition to an increased Imperial presence,<ref name="GCWForum" /> another significant modification made to the city during this update was the inclusion of a political election system in which players could vote for either Sean Trenwell or Victor Visalis as the aide to Governor Tour Aryon.<ref name="Publish 6" /><ref name="AED" /> Each candidate had their own quests and rewards. The quests were to gather positive evidence that demonstrated why either candidate would do a better job as the governor's right hand man. Players who took these quests were required to find evidence of good deeds by either candidate, and turn it in to the governor in the hopes of getting enough evidence to cause the governor to select their chosen candidate. Each candidate was in power for two full months, and at the end of the election month, the governor would count up the pieces of evidence turned in by the players and select her new aide.<ref name="Politics" /> Different city events would occur depending on which aide to the governor was in control. Sand People had the potential to raid Bestine, the Imperial presence could increase, and players could have the option to seek out historians for quests to learn more about the genuine history of Bestine. The update also included a new Bestine Museum event,<ref name="Publish 6" /> in which players could vote for their favorite painting to be exhibited.<ref name="AED" />

As part of the Galactic Civil War planetary control game, Bestine was designated as an Imperial stronghold which could not be occupied by Rebel forces.<ref name="GCWForum" /> However, the developers overhauled the Galactic Civil War system as part of [[W:c:swg:Game Update 15|Game Update 15]] on [[January 15]], [[2010]]. With the update, Bestine was designated as an invasion city, along with Dearic and Keren.<ref name="SOEBtS" /> Whichever faction controlled the Bestine planetary region would occupy the city and be designated as the defending force. Every three hours, an invasion of Bestine would be carried out by the opposing faction.<ref name="AED" /> This included a thirty minute preparation phase in which defending players would manufacture equipment, scout the city defenses, and entertain troops. The invasion phase lasted another thirty minutes, during which the objective was to defend the city from the enemy. Preventing the enemy from killing the defending general in the center of the city won the conflict for the defenders, while killing the defending general in the center of the city won the city for the attackers.<ref name="SOEBtS" /> Because the conduct of the sieges depended on the players input, the [[canon]]ical results of the invasion cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. However, this article assumes 100% game completion, and that both factions were successful in invading and occupying the city at various points during the Galactic Civil War. Because Bestine was the Imperial capital by default,<ref name="AED" /> and the ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™ Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege (Game Update 15) news article indicates that the Imperials were still in control of the city, this article assumes that the Rebels were the first faction to kick off the invasion of Bestine.<ref name="UnderSiege" />
